name: Write Vault File
description: Write a file to the user's personal vault. Creates the file if it does not exist; overwrites if it does. Use vault:mkdir first to create parent directories. Supply exactly one of content, value, bytes (base64), or asset. Large binary uploads should use WebDAV PUT.
creator: Covia

value.description: JSON-serialisable value to write as UTF-8 JSON

asset.description: Asset reference to write as file content (e.g. '/a/0x1234...', DID URL). Streams binary directly.

created.description: True if file was newly created
